title_en: Measure, Tomche, a Hundred Drams of Halva
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Шеќерлија' could mean a confectioner or a sweet-lover; I read it as a confectioner/sweet-seller. Tomche is a personal name.

words_to_learn.en: sweet-maker or seller; one who loves sweets

lines.en: Measure out, Tomche, a hundred drams of halva,
a hundred drams of halva, Tomche, you sweet-seller.
to the girls, Tomche, across the river.

lines.cyr: Ако те питат од кого е,
lines.lat: Ako te pitat od kogo e,
lines.en: If they ask you whose it is,

lines.cyr: ти да кажеш, Томчо, од мене е.
lines.lat: ti da kažeš, Tomčo, od mene e.
lines.en: you should say, Tomche, that it is from me.
